description: This file defines the PerformanceMetrics class and related interfaces for plugin performance monitoring within the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for configuration, notifications, and various metrics loggers, as well as handlers for plugin callsign and classname based metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing performance metrics collection and reporting, including nested classes for configuration, notifications, and various loggers.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::Config
classes.description: JSON configuration container for observable callsign and classname.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for plugin activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IStateMetricsLogger
classes.description: Interface extending IBasicMetricsLogger for state-related metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IBrowserMetricsLogger
classes.description: Interface extending IStateMetricsLogger for browser-specific metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IObservable
classes.description: Interface for observable entities that can be enabled or disabled.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IPerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Interface for plugin performance metrics handlers.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::CallsignPerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles metrics based on plugin callsign.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::ClassnamePerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles metrics based on plugin classname.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::LoggerProxy
classes.description: Template class providing a logger instance for metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::BasicObservable
classes.description: Base class for observable metrics, managing activation time and service reference.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::StateObservable
classes.description: Extends BasicObservable with state change notifications.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::WebBrowserObservable
classes.description: Extends StateObservable with web browser-specific notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.
